name: Jan
tagline: Open-source offline desktop AI assistant with built-in model hub, local chat workspace, and localhost API.
real_test_summary: Tested as a local desktop replacement for cloud chat apps with downloaded GGUF models. Stores conversations locally on disk, works completely offline, and exposes an OpenAI-compatible local server.
pros: Clean desktop app with one-click model downloads and local conversation storage
Fully open-source under AGPL-3.0 with no account sign-up required
Includes a local OpenAI-compatible API server for external developer tools
cons: Desktop Electron shell uses more background RAM than CLI-only runners
Large local models still require substantial disk space and memory
